---
title: "Framework Report"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output:
  pdf_document:
    toc: true
    toc_depth: 3
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_depth: 3
    css: styles.css
params: 
  results: "[results]"
  file: "[file]"
---

## Summary

**File**: `r paste0(params$file, ".csv")`

```{r, echo = FALSE}
outputs <- character()

for (entry in params$results) {

	# Determine the type of the entry
	if ("mks" %in% names(entry)) {
		name <- "Change Point Analysis"
	} else if ("mk" %in% names(entry)) {
		name <- "Trend Detection"
	} else if ("assessment" %in% names(entry)) {
		name <- "Frequency Analysis"
	} else {
		name <- "Unknown"
	}

	# Create a string defining the start/end years
	period <- glue("{entry$start}-{entry$end}")

	# Add a header to outputs	
	header <- glue("\n\n## {name} ({period})\n\n")
	outputs <- c(outputs, header)

	# Create a list with the start year, end year, img path
	period <- list(
		start = entry$start,
		end = entry$end,
		img_path = file.path(renv::project(), "reports", params$file, "img")
	)

	# Add the sub-report for each item in the entry
	for (item in names(entry)) {

		env <- new.env()
		env$params <- c(entry[[item]], period)
		report_file <- glue("{item}-report.Rmd")

		# Check if report file exists (TEMPORARY)
		if (file.exists(report_file)) {
			outputs <- c(outputs, knitr::knit_child(report_file, envir = env))
		}
	}

} 

knitr::asis_output(outputs)
```
